title: How We Pushed CDC into Postgres
summary: Snowflake's engineering team explains how they implemented CDC (Change Data Capture) to enable real-time replication from PostgreSQL to Snowflake's data warehouse platform. The blog details the technical challenges and solutions for streaming database changes at scale.
problem_solved: Enables near real-time data synchronization from PostgreSQL databases to Snowflake for analytics and data warehousing purposes.
why_valuable: Provides a robust solution for organizations needing to continuously sync PostgreSQL data to Snowflake without manual ETL processes or batch loads.
